text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "postHistory.UserId identifies site users (a foreign key to a users table), while comments.Id is the comment's own primary key, and the high containment is merely chance overlap of dense integer ID ranges (user IDs up to ~56k fall inside the 1–221k comment ID space, with only 11% coverage and a separate comments.UserId column confirming Id is not a user reference)."}
